CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red set), its organization/presentation (explicit coordinate set) and a separate origin/status field are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition tied to the identified content's presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies represented content (red) and its coordinate attribute for a named referent/time.

D.rationale: An origin/status field is presented separately from the content coordinate listing for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The organization/presentation of the identified content is explicitly given as coordinate sets bound to the referent/time.
